title: Emphasis: にしても, といっても, どころか, さえ, さえ〜ば, こそ, ばかりでなく
description: Even if / even so, although I say, far from, even, if only, precisely, and not only … but also.

points.title: 〜にしても: even if, even so; whether … or …
points.summary: Plain / noun + にしても = even granting that … (still). AにしてもBにしても = whether A or B.
points.body:
- 冗談**にしても**、それは言いすぎだ (even as a joke, that's too much).
- 行く**にしても**行かない**にしても**、連絡してください.

Compare にしては (considering) — different meaning!
examples: {冗談|じょうだん}にしても、それは{言|い}いすぎだよ。
Even as a joke, that's going too far.

points.title: 〜といっても: although I say …, but actually
points.summary: Plain / noun + といっても = 'I say A, but it's not as much as you'd think'.
points.body:
- 料理ができる**といっても**、簡単なものだけです.
- 休み**といっても**、一日だけです.

It lowers expectations created by the first statement.
examples: {料理|りょうり}ができるといっても、{簡単|かんたん}なものだけです。
I can cook, but only simple things.

points.title: 〜どころか: far from, let alone
points.summary: Plain / noun + どころか = not only not A, but (the opposite / even less) B.
points.body:
- 彼は漢字**どころか**、ひらがなも読めない (let alone kanji, he can't even read hiragana).
- 休む**どころか**、もっと忙しくなった (far from resting, I got busier).
examples: {彼|かれ}は{漢字|かんじ}どころか、ひらがなも{読|よ}めない。
He can't even read hiragana, let alone kanji.

points.title: 〜さえ: even
points.summary: Noun + さえ = even (an extreme example). で/に + さえ: 子供でさえ.
points.body:
- 忙しくて、寝る時間**さえ**ない.
- 子供で**さえ**わかる問題だ.

さえ replaces が/を; with other particles it follows them (子供で**さえ**, 先生に**さえ**).
examples: {忙|いそが}しくて、{寝|ね}る{時間|じかん}さえない。
I'm so busy I don't even have time to sleep.

points.title: 〜さえ〜ば: if only, as long as
points.summary: Noun + さえ + ば-form / ます-stem + さえすれば = as long as A, (B follows).
points.body:
- 時間**さえ**あれ**ば**、旅行に行けるのに.
- この薬を飲み**さえ**すれ**ば**、すぐ治る.
examples: {時間|じかん}さえあれば、{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}けるのに。
If only I had time, I could travel.

points.title: 〜こそ: precisely, (this time) for sure
points.summary: Noun + こそ = strong emphasis: it's exactly this one. こちらこそ, 今年こそ.
points.body:
- **こちらこそ**、よろしくお願いします (likewise / it's me who should say that).
- 今年**こそ**合格するぞ！ (this year for sure!).
examples: {今年|ことし}こそ{合格|ごうかく}するぞ！
This year I'll pass for sure!

points.title: 〜ばかりでなく: not only … but also
points.summary: Plain / noun + ばかりでなく … も = not only A, but also B. Same as だけでなく.
points.body:
- 彼は英語**ばかりでなく**、中国語**も**話せる.
- この店は安い**ばかりでなく**、おいしい.
examples: {彼|かれ}は{英語|えいご}ばかりでなく、{中国語|ちゅうごくご}も{話|はな}せる。
He can speak not only English but also Chinese.

questions.prompt: {冗談|じょうだん}（　）、それは{言|い}いすぎだよ。
notes: にとっても = 'also for (someone)'.
こそ emphasises ('precisely a joke') — it doesn't fit 'even if it's a joke'.
についても = 'also about'.
questions.translation: Even as a joke, that's going too far.

questions.prompt: {行|い}く（　）{行|い}かない（　）、{連絡|れんらく}してください。
questions.explanation: Whether A or B: **AにしてもBにしても**.
notes: にしては = 'considering' — not 'whether … or'.
として = 'as'.
によって = 'depending on' — would need different grammar (行くかどうかによって).
questions.translation: Whether you go or not, please let me know.

questions.prompt: {料理|りょうり}ができる（　）、{簡単|かんたん}なものだけです。
notes: ということ = 'the fact that'.
というより = 'rather than'.
どころか = 'far from' — it would need the opposite after it.
questions.translation: I can cook, but only simple things.

questions.prompt: {休|やす}みと（　）、{一日|いちにち}だけです。
notes: というより = 'rather than'.
といえば = 'speaking of'.
というと = 'speaking of'.
questions.translation: I do have a day off, but it's only one day.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{漢字|かんじ}（　）、ひらがなも{読|よ}めない。
questions.explanation: Let alone / far from: **どころか**.
notes: ところか isn't a form (voiced ど).
どころが isn't a form.
ところが = 'however' (sentence connector).
questions.translation: He can't even read hiragana, let alone kanji.

questions.prompt: What does 「{休|やす}むどころか、もっと{忙|いそが}しくなった」 mean?
options: I rested a little and was busy.
Instead of being busy, I rested.
Far from resting, I got even busier.
questions.explanation: どころか = far from A, actually the opposite.
notes: That ignores どころか.
The reverse.
That ignores どころか.

questions.prompt: {忙|いそが}しくて、{寝|ね}る{時間|じかん}（　）ない。
notes: 寝る時間ほどない isn't natural.
寝る時間くらいない isn't natural.
こそ emphasises positively — doesn't fit 'not even'.
questions.translation: I'm so busy I don't even have time to sleep.

questions.prompt: これは{子供|こども}で（　）わかる{問題|もんだい}だ。
notes: でこそ = 'precisely as a child' — wrong meaning.
しか needs a negative verb.
子供でだけ = 'only as a child' — wrong.
questions.translation: This is a problem even a child could solve.

questions.prompt: {時間|じかん}（　）あれば、{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}けるのに。
notes: こそあれば isn't the pattern.
しか needs a negative.
ほどあれば isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: If only I had time, I could travel.

questions.prompt: この{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}み（　）すれば、すぐ{治|なお}る。
questions.explanation: Stem + **さえすれば** = as long as you ….
notes: 飲みほど isn't a form.
しか needs a negative.
飲みこそすれば isn't natural.
questions.translation: As long as you take this medicine, you'll get better quickly.

questions.prompt: A：よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。　B：こちら（　）、よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
notes: こちらだけ = 'only this side'.
こちらさえ = 'even this side'.
しか needs a negative.
questions.translation: A: Nice to work with you. B: Likewise.

questions.prompt: {去年|きょねん}は{失敗|しっぱい}したけど、{今年|ことし}（　）{合格|ごうかく}するぞ！
questions.explanation: This time for sure: **今年こそ**.
notes: 今年さえ = 'even this year'.
今年ほど isn't emphatic here.
しか needs a negative.
questions.translation: I failed last year, but this year I'll pass for sure!

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{英語|えいご}（　）、{中国語|ちゅうごくご}も{話|はな}せる。
questions.explanation: Not only … but also: **ばかりでなく … も**.
notes: だけで = 'just by' — missing なく.
ばかりで = 'only' — missing なく.
しかなく isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: He can speak not only English but also Chinese.

questions.prompt: この{店|みせ}は{安|やす}い（　）、おいしい。
notes: で is missing.
ばかりにない isn't a form.
ばかりでない ends a clause — it can't connect to the next part (でなく is needed).
questions.translation: This shop is not only cheap but also tasty.
